# SR1 test technologies: comments, nested blocks, comparisons and a variable, as in the game's files.
@cost_two = 2

technologies = {
	steady_tech = {
		research_cost = 1.5
		start_year = 1936
		path = {
			leads_to_tech = future_tech
			research_cost_coeff = 1
		}
		categories = { industry }
		ai_will_do = {
			factor = 1
			modifier = { factor = 0 date < 1938.1.1 }
		}
	}

	future_tech = {
		research_cost = @cost_two	# 200 points with BASE_TECH_COST = 100
		start_year = 1941
		allow = { has_war_support > 0.5 }
	}

	basic_tech = {
		research_cost = 1
		start_year = 1936
	}
}
